steps.text: Dash says his friend Pip has been waiting by the portal all day to show you something. Go and say hi!
The Void's got new things to try tonight.
checklist: Help Pip with the boardwalk lamps (say yes to Pip)
Find a letter of S-K-A-T-E in the Skate Park

reward.message: Pip's Lamps done! The Goals page in your menu shows what to try next. Pip says Bramble's waiting for you by the portal! (+8 sparkles)
